Optional GUI dashboard included, plus a standalone CL"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"I and an MCP server for **Trae, Qoder, Cursor, Claude Desktop** and any other platform."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"See README.zh.md for the full documentation (中文)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"1. **Build & run check** — detect the project type (Node/Python/Rust/Go/C++/Java/.NET/static web/Ele"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ctron/desktop exe), install deps, run ALL build commands, start a run probe, and collect every error"},{"id":"p6s3","text":". 2. **Feature completeness"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"** — extract ALL of the user's requirements from the prompt/context, then verify each one against th"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"e implementation (heuristic keyword/structure checks + optional LLM deep analysis + **behavioral ver"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"ification: open the project like a real user — web via Playwright-rendered page text, CLI via --help"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"/--version output — and check whether the required feature is actually visible**). Missing features "},{"id":"p6s9","text":"are collected and reported **all at once**; step 3 runs only when step 1 and step 2 both pass.
3. **"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"Real user simulation** — **first run the project's automated tests** (Node projects: `pnpm test`; no"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"n-Node projects: the equivalent test command such as `cargo test`/`go test ./...`/`pytest`/`mvn test"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"`/`dotnet test`), recording any test failure as an error; then operate the software like a real user"},{"id":"p6s13","text":" (keyboard, mouse clicks/drags): web apps (and any GUI project such as a DSH plugin panel) via HTTP "},{"id":"p6s14","text":"probes + Playwright, Windows desktop apps via UIA with real input events, CLIs via driven commands —"},{"id":"p6s15","text":" following the user's described features (or README.md). For web/GUI projects the simulator also **a"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"udits every page it reaches** (detecting pages stuck on a URL or stuck on a "loading" indicator) and"},{"id":"p6s17","text":" **clicks every button on each page** (recording the state/any anomaly after each click). **Any proj"},{"id":"p6s18","text":"ect with a GUI (user interface) MUST run the GUI simulation when steps 1–2 pass** — a GUI project ne"},{"id":"p6s19","text":"ver falls back to CLI simulation. Freezes, unresponsiveness, errors and crashes are recorded and rep"},{"id":"p6s20","text":"orted to the AI. - **engine/** — framework-agnostic check e"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ngine: types, filesystem utilities, project detection, requirement extraction, step 1 (build & run),"},{"id":"p16s6","text":" step 2 (completeness + behavioral verification via opening the project), step 3 (user simulation), "},{"id":"p16s7","text":"report rendering, and the runCheck() orchestrator.
- **cli/** — standalone CLI + MCP stdio server fo"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"r any platform (child_process adapters, OpenAI-compatible analyzer).

- **t"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"ests/** — engine + harness-layer unit tests (node --test).

- **需求.txt** — this plugin's own requirements document (used by the self-check)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## LLM — what is it, and do I need an API key?"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The LLM is the plugin's optional deep-analysis layer (steps 2 & 3 only; step 1 and the actual simula"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"tion execution never use it):"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- Step 2: an LLM judges each requirement as implemented/partial/missing with evidence and fix sugges"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"tions (more accurate than the heuristic fallback).

3. **No LLM at all**: set us"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"eLlm: false in the config, or pass --no-llm to the CLI — zero tokens, zero keys."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
